plan: Given the private value of $25, I aim to bid slightly below my value to ensure potential profit if I win. Bidding exactly my value or slightly less maximizes potential gain while minimizing loss if I win. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their values, so bidding $24.9 could secure the win against slightly lower bids while maintaining a small profit margin.

Given my private value of $3, I should aim to bid below this value to ensure a profit if I win. Since all bidders are rational, they will also bid below their private values. A bid of $2.5 could allow me to win if others bid conservatively, while ensuring I don't overpay relative to my value.

Given my value of $26, I should bid slightly below this to maximize profit while ensuring a chance of winning. Bidding exactly $26 risks zero profit if I win. Bidding slightly lower, like $25.9, could win if others undervalue. This balances winning probability and potential profit.
